_README: Full condition set for study.py. Every condition changes ONE setting from
baseline and runs on the SAME fixed 40 recordings.
DESIGN NOTE. An earlier version of this file excluded parameters on the
grounds that published work reported them inert. That was the wrong call.
Citing a paper and testing a parameter are different decisions: a measured
null result WITH a supporting citation is far stronger than an untested
assumption. Where the literature made a prediction, it is noted below so the
result can be reported as agreeing or disagreeing with it.
Roughly 30 min per GPU condition. Post-processing conditions are free -
they recompute from cached JSON without re-transcribing.

_S1_MODEL: model size. MMedFD (arXiv:2509.19817) found scaling small->large-v3 improved WER 53->13 percent while WORSENING healthcare-term error 15->37 percent. Judge these on CLINICAL metrics, not WER.
_S2_PRECISION: compute precision. Previously confounded with another change, so never cleanly measured.
_S3_BEAM: beam search width. Whisper and WhisperX default to 5. Prior testing on two recordings found no stable optimum - which is expected if the effect is smaller than the noise floor.
_S4_BEAMSHAPE: beam search shape. Kasai et al. (arXiv:2204.05424) introduced patience and report gains on summarisation and machine translation; the paper contains NO ASR evaluation. Testing it on clinical dialogue is therefore genuinely open.
_S5_REPETITION: repetition control. A Bangla long-form study (arXiv:2602.21741) found aggressive settings HURT by blocking legitimate repeats. This corpus contains many (no no no, very very painful), so the risk is real here.
_S6_THRESHOLDS: decoding thresholds at MID-RANGE values. Prior testing set these to None, which disables the fallback entirely. Nudging them is a different question and has never been examined on this audio.
_S7_CONTEXT: previous-text conditioning. WhisperX disables this by default to reduce hallucination; OpenAI note it can cause failure loops. Previously tested only in combination with a compute change, so confounded.
_S8_VAD: voice activity detection. Measured 2.3 points worse when disabled on two recordings - re-tested here at proper scale, plus its sub-parameters.
_S9_POSTPROC: speaker grouping. FREE - recomputed from cached JSON. Note MIN_INTERVAL_DURATION also DELETES words in dropped intervals, so report it against WER as well as WDER.
_S10_TPE: TPE winners re-evaluated on the same 40-recording subset. Selected on a separate 14-consultation split; these runs make their WER comparable with the one-factor family.
